## Skills

- AI: multi-agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM orchestration, function calling, LLM evaluation
- Mobile: Flutter, Kotlin
- Web and backend: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, microservices

## Experience

- Software Engineer, Prodoc AI, Bangalore (Mar 2025 - Present): owns a production multi-agent AI platform for healthcare, including agent orchestration, RAG, tool calling, memory and human-in-the-loop escalation. Also builds an MCP tool server, an LLM evaluation suite, mobile apps and messaging platforms.
- AI/ML Intern, Havric AI, Bangalore (Nov 2024 - Feb 2025): built a scalable conversational AI chatbot.
- Flutter Developer Intern, CSTech Info Solutions, Bangalore (Mar 2024 - Oct 2024): built a cross-platform mobile app with Flutter for Android and iOS.
- Developer Executive, AIE Technologies (Sep 2023 - Nov 2023): built an end-to-end application with a Flask and MongoDB backend.
